map.name: Tolm
map.setting: a farming town troubled by Ogres
map.trouble: The Ogre Warlord Bolgrum holds Krog Durm above the Village of Tolm and his Ogres raid its farms. Ondrel sent the player to help Mayor Corbel.

guard_bark.specifics: Dorrik keeps the east gate, shut by Mayor Corbel while the Ogres raid the fields.

first.speaker: Dorrik
first.text: Mayor Corbel has shut the east gate until somebody chases the Ogres out of the bean fields. Somebody ought to go and get Zelna. She usually just puts the Ogres to sleep instead of fighting them.

again.speaker: Dorrik
again.text: I'm afraid old Hobb has finally lost his wits. They've put me on his gate now that he's taken up sleeping in the hayloft and hooting at the moon all night.

later.speaker: Dorrik
later.text: We must save the granary! Drive back the Ogres and shut the east gate.

bounty_offer.specifics: Brunn, a pig farmer, has lost his pigs to Bears and wants them hunted down.

offer.speaker: Brunn
offer.text:
Truth be told, my farm's been doing rather poorly of late. Ten nights back, Bears broke into the sty and dragged off my pigs.

I don't suppose I'll ever get my pigs back, but I'd like nothing better than to see those Bears hunted down.

I'll gladly pay whoever puts an end to them.

reminder.speaker: Brunn
reminder.text: Any luck with those Bears? They had another pig last night!

completion.speaker: Brunn
completion.text:
So those Bears are finished! Good work, lad! My pigs can rest easy knowing those brutes won't be shoving their big hairy snouts in my sty!

And here's what I promised... 90 gold pieces! You're welcome at my farm anytime!

journal.text: Hunt down the Bears that have been stealing Brunn's pigs.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Vessa's Rain Staff was taken by an Ogre who beat her farmhands, bound for Krog Durm.

offer.speaker: Vessa
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? That Ogre brute knocked down both of my farmhands. The guards will never get here in time. Please, will you catch him before he carries the Rain Staff off to Krog Durm?

refusal.speaker: Vessa
refusal.text: Oh.... Then the Rain Staff is gone for good.

reminder.speaker: Vessa
reminder.text: Please, I'm begging you. Run down that thieving Ogre and bring back the Rain Staff.

completion.speaker: Vessa
completion.text: The Rain Staff is safe! You will need my old Ankh more than I will, up at Krog Durm. Here, take it with you.

after.speaker: Vessa
after.text: You may have saved every field in Tolm with your bold deeds. Well done, young sir! Now, hurry on to Mayor Corbel.

journal.text: Recover the Rain Staff stolen from Vessa by an Ogre.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Rain Staff stolen from Vessa by an Ogre.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Tolm: Pella, Nella and old Hobb.

rumour1.speaker: Pella
rumour1.text: Yaaaaagh! Get it out of my apron!

rumour2.speaker: Nella
rumour2.text: Oh, you're back. Have the Ogres been beaten, yet?

rumour3.speaker: Hobb
rumour3.text: Is it true what folks say about Ogres?

shop_greeting.specifics: Bramwick keeps the inn, Kettick the smithy, Zelna the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bramwick
inn.text: A stranger, eh? You'd best turn around and go home. Mark my words, Bolgrum will be stomping through Tolm before long, too! Hard times we're having, isn't it?

arms.speaker: Kettick
arms.text: Ogres trampled the barley. Need a sword?

magic.speaker: Zelna
magic.text: What is it you want, Wanderer? I'm very busy.

two_givers.specifics: Tamm sits in the lockup at the Town Hall and offers a way into Krog Durm. Hulda needs him back at her cider press for the harvest.

offer_a.speaker: Tamm
offer_a.text: Hello there. Folks call me Tamm. Can you spring me from this lockup? Do that, and I'll show you a way into Krog Durm.

offer_b.speaker: Hulda
offer_b.text:
Oh, for pity's sake! Tamm's in the lockup again?! Sometimes I think he gets caught on purpose just to dodge his chores. It's hard work running a cider press, you know. The whole apple crop is coming in today and I need Tamm at the press when the carts pull up.

Tell you what... Spring Tamm from the lockup and you can have one of the chain tunics the peddler owes me!

outcome_a.speaker: Tamm
outcome_a.text: Thank you for getting me out. Take this gold as token of my thanks. Oh, I nearly forgot! Here's a key to the back gate of Krog Durm. Mind yourself in there. The Ogres won't take kindly to a stranger sneaking round their fort. Thanks again!

outcome_b.speaker: Hulda
outcome_b.text: Tamm! What were you thinking, getting yourself locked up on harvest day? Thanks for springing him, stranger! Here's the chain tunic, like I said. Good luck with whatever it is you're up to!

journal_a.text: Get Tamm out of the lockup in the Town Hall.

journal_b.text: Free Tamm and return him to Hulda's cider press.

rescue.specifics: Nella's grandpa Olm is trapped in the root cellar under her barn, knocked flat by the Ogres.

plea.speaker: Nella
plea.text:
Oh, please, stranger, help me! The Ogres have knocked my barn flat and my poor old grandpa, Olm, is stuck down in the root cellar under it!

Get him out and I'll owe you for the rest of my days!

reminder.speaker: Nella
reminder.text: Whatever you find down in that cellar is yours to keep! Just hurry and get Grandpa out!

found.speaker: Olm
found.text: Who's that? Get these beams off me!

following.speaker: Olm
following.text: Go on, I'm right behind you!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text:
Thank goodness, you got him out! However can I repay you for your courage?!

What's that you say? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if you insist, then please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Grandpa Olm from the wrecked barn in Tolm.

main_opening.specifics: Fulk points the player to Mayor Corbel in the Town Hall, who sends him against the Ogre Warlord Bolgrum at Krog Durm.

herald.speaker: Fulk
herald.text: We'll hold the fences here, but you must go see Mayor Corbel in the Town Hall. Thanks for coming, brave Adventurer!

opening.speaker: Corbel
opening.text:
Sorry about the smell, lad, but the Ogres dumped a whole cart of manure on our doorstep last night. They have scouts in the fields and many more up at Krog Durm.

It is vital that Warlord Bolgrum be driven out, but his Ogres won't just step aside for you. This could turn very nasty. Still, these potions will help.

reminder.speaker: Corbel
reminder.text: The healing potions will be invaluable once the Ogres gang up on you. The Cure Poison potion will help against their filthy rusty blades. Good luck, and hurry!

journal.text: Break into Krog Durm and drive out Warlord Bolgrum.
